module_name: Research Methods for Computing and Technology
context: The module covers aspects of research techniques, data analysis and the presentation of a research proposal and investigation as a preparation for students to complete their Investigation Report of final-year project. This module introduces Computing & IT students basic understanding and knowledge of the range of techniques and methods available for problem analysis and investigation. Problem is addressed through the creation of a software artefact.

tasks.text: Project Proposal (Literature Review & Methodology): Target about 3,500 words. Covering Literature review (coverage, synthesis and critical analysis of current research), Comparison of similar systems and identification of the research gap, and Research methodology (design, target users, sampling, data collection, analysis, ethics and limitations).
